title: Concrete Pumping Pressure, Slump and Aggregate
seoTitle: Concrete Pumping Pressure, Slump and Aggregate | Pinjin
description: Read outlet pressure from the Pinjin catalogue and slump/aggregate limits from ACI 304.2R-17. No factory-invented pressure–slump formula. Electric 20 is 10 MPa; Electric 30 and Low Pressure 40 are 20 MPa; Electric 40 is 23 MPa.

relatedPaths.label: Fine stone pump aggregate size selection

answerBlock.what: Pumping pressure on a Pinjin page is the published max outlet pressure, not a site-calculated friction number. Electric 20 lists 10 MPa; Electric 30 and Low Pressure 40 list 20 MPa; Electric 40 lists 23 MPa. ACI 304.2R-17 treats 2–6 in (50–150 mm) slump as the traditional target for conventional mixtures without admixtures, and limits coarse aggregate to one-third (angular) or two-fifths (rounded) of the smallest pipeline inside diameter. We do not publish a Pinjin pressure–slump equation.
answerBlock.who: Engineers and buyers who need to line up mix slump and stone with a catalogue pressure row before inquiring.
factors: Catalogue max outlet pressure on the pump page
Max aggregate and, where printed, fine-stone versus agg13 distance
ACI 304.2R-17 slump band and aggregate-to-pipe limits as cited industry guidance
Pipeline length and DN — distance is a catalogue pair, not a derived formula here

faqs.question: Does Pinjin publish a formula that converts slump into outlet pressure?
faqs.answer: No. We print outlet pressure, output, hopper and conveying distance. Slump target ranges in this article are quoted from ACI 304.2R-17, not from a factory equation.

faqs.question: Is Low Pressure 40 a 10 MPa pump?
faqs.answer: No. Its catalogue max outlet pressure is 20 MPa, the same band as Electric 30. ‘Low pressure’ on that page is a fine-stone tune, explained in the Low Pressure 40 guide.
